title: 指标口径一致性检查：同一 GMV 指标在两个 ADS 表的差异
code:
# 指标口径一致性：同一指标在两个 ADS 表中的计算结果比对
# 原子指标（规范化定义）：成功支付的订单金额合计
ATOMIC_METRIC = {
    "name": "gmv_pay_amt",
    "measure_field": "pay_amount",
    "agg": "SUM",
    "business_limit": "pay_status = paid AND refund_flag = 0",
    "time_field": "pay_time",
}

# (订单号, 状态, 是否退款, 下单金额, 实付金额)
ORDERS = [
    ("O1", "paid",    0, 120, 100),
    ("O2", "paid",    0, 200, 180),
    ("O3", "unpaid",  0, 300, 0),
    ("O4", "paid",    1, 150, 150),
    ("O5", "paid",    0, 90,  90),
    ("O6", "cancel",  0, 400, 0),
]

# 两个 ADS 表各自声明的口径
SPEC_A = {"table": "ads_trade_overview", "field": "pay_amount",
          "filters": ["pay_status = paid", "refund_flag = 0"]}
SPEC_B = {"table": "ads_finance_report", "field": "order_amount",
          "filters": []}


def compute(field, filters):
    """按给定口径计算 GV（成交金额）指标。"""
    total = 0
    cnt = 0
    for oid, status, refund, order_amt, pay_amt in ORDERS:
        if "pay_status = paid" in filters and status != "paid":
            continue
        if "refund_flag = 0" in filters and refund != 0:
            continue
        if field == "pay_amount":
            total += pay_amt
        else:
            total += order_amt
        cnt += 1
    return {"cnt": cnt, "amt": total}


def check_spec(spec):
    """把表口径与原子指标定义逐项比对，返回不一致项。"""
    issues = []
    if spec["field"] != ATOMIC_METRIC["measure_field"]:
        issues.append("度量字段不一致: " + spec["field"] + " != " + ATOMIC_METRIC["measure_field"])
    want = set(x.strip() for x in ATOMIC_METRIC["business_limit"].split("AND"))
    got = set(f.strip() for f in spec["filters"])
    if got != want:
        issues.append("业务限定不一致: 缺 " + str(sorted(want - got)) +
                      "，多 " + str(sorted(got - want)))
    return issues


canon = compute(ATOMIC_METRIC["measure_field"], ["pay_status = paid", "refund_flag = 0"])
res_a = compute(SPEC_A["field"], SPEC_A["filters"])
res_b = compute(SPEC_B["field"], SPEC_B["filters"])

print("原子指标定义 = " + ATOMIC_METRIC["name"])
print("  度量字段 = " + ATOMIC_METRIC["measure_field"] + "，聚合方式 = " + ATOMIC_METRIC["agg"])
print("  业务限定 = " + ATOMIC_METRIC["business_limit"])
print("  时间口径 = " + ATOMIC_METRIC["time_field"] + " 所在分区")
print("")
print("== 各口径计算结果 ==")
print("  基准（按原子指标定义）: 笔数=" + str(canon["cnt"]) + " 金额=" + str(canon["amt"]))
print("  " + SPEC_A["table"] + ": 笔数=" + str(res_a["cnt"]) + " 金额=" + str(res_a["amt"]))
print("  " + SPEC_B["table"] + ": 笔数=" + str(res_b["cnt"]) + " 金额=" + str(res_b["amt"]))
print("")
print("== 口径声明比对 ==")
ia = check_spec(SPEC_A)
ib = check_spec(SPEC_B)
print("  " + SPEC_A["table"] + " 不一致项 = " + (str(ia) if ia else "无"))
print("  " + SPEC_B["table"] + " 不一致项 = " + (str(ib) if ib else "无"))
print("")
diff_a = canon["amt"] - res_a["amt"]
diff_b = canon["amt"] - res_b["amt"]
print("  金额差额(基准 - ads_trade_overview) = " + str(diff_a))
print("  金额差额(基准 - ads_finance_report) = " + str(diff_b))
print("")
print("判据 1（口径一致的表与基准结果相同，差额=0）: " + str(diff_a == 0 and not ia))
print("判据 2（口径不一致的表被检出：声明不一致 且 结果有差额）: " +
      str(bool(ib) and diff_b != 0))
print("判据 3（同一指标在不同 ADS 表出现不同数值 = 口径漂移）: " +
      str(res_a["amt"] != res_b["amt"]))
expected_output:
原子指标定义 = gmv_pay_amt
  度量字段 = pay_amount，聚合方式 = SUM
  业务限定 = pay_status = paid AND refund_flag = 0
  时间口径 = pay_time 所在分区

== 各口径计算结果 ==
  基准（按原子指标定义）: 笔数=3 金额=370
  ads_trade_overview: 笔数=3 金额=370
  ads_finance_report: 笔数=6 金额=1260

== 口径声明比对 ==
  ads_trade_overview 不一致项 = 无
  ads_finance_report 不一致项 = ['度量字段不一致: order_amount != pay_amount', "业务限定不一致: 缺 ['pay_status = paid', 'refund_flag = 0']，多 []"]

  金额差额(基准 - ads_trade_overview) = 0
  金额差额(基准 - ads_finance_report) = -890

判据 1（口径一致的表与基准结果相同，差额=0）: True
判据 2（口径不一致的表被检出：声明不一致 且 结果有差额）: True
判据 3（同一指标在不同 ADS 表出现不同数值 = 口径漂移）: True
